drag.cancel: Escape/lost capture/window deactivation restore initial ratio and release capture
drag.clamp_rule: apply content minima first; if infeasible collapse into switchable panels; never produce minRatio > maxRatio

ime.escape_during_composition: IME handles first; do not dismiss ancestor dialog
ime.send_ack_rule: persist immutable draft/outbox entry before submission; clear the matching draft only after durable acceptance; idempotency key required for retry

scroll.repin: explicit jump-to-latest or user intentionally returns to bottom; never by timer alone
scroll.stream_reveal: append without blur or glyph motion
scroll.unpin: any user upward intent immediately enters reading-history, even within tolerance

explicit_viewport_reveal.coordinates: document-local Rect; stable Content item mapping is a separate composition responsibility, not consumer pixel compensation
placement: nearest uses the smallest movement into the comfort zone; an oversized item already spanning it stays stable
centered aligns the target center with the possibly asymmetric comfort zone center

Start(existing Axis) aligns the selected document axis to the comfort-zone start even when already visible or viewport-tall; the unselected axis retains its document offset; default Nearest and existing Centered unchanged.
explicit_viewport_reveal.margins: reuse Insets, finite and nonnegative, opposing sums strictly below viewport extent; malformed requests do not cancel or move existing input/motion
explicit_viewport_reveal.clamping: use existing per-axis policies and document limits; report clamped placement explicitly
explicit_viewport_reveal.motion: reuse motion.duration.geometry and the existing standard disclosure_reveal easing binding through ProgressTransition; host tick only; Reduced Motion immediate, preference changes finish at the clamped target
explicit_viewport_reveal.competition: explicit reveal cancels old gesture/elastic ownership and fences old momentum; fresh non-momentum input interrupts navigation, including a delta without phase-began; retarget from current position; lifecycle and geometry changes stop stale navigation
explicit_viewport_reveal.legacy: ordinary reveal/reveal_focus retain immediate geometry and focus-ring rules; a legacy reveal cancels only a new explicit navigation animation
explicit_viewport_reveal.acceptance_boundary: viewport primitive tested independently; Issue28 additionally requires owner/version/mount-safe item traversal, real nested consumer, native and Gold7 acceptance

stable_item_reveal.entry: ContentHost::reveal_scroll_reading_item(original owner,retained ReadingDocumentVersion,stable declared ComponentId,existing ScrollRevealOptions,current ButtonTextRenderer)
stable_item_reveal.services: reuse current original text/IME backend; first successful render establishes geometry. Layout/resource failure requires another successful render before retry. Reuse existing post-measure/arrange preflight; no synthetic editor/backend/coordinates.
stable_item_reveal.identity: validate original attachment/revision before layout, declaration and original per-revision item mount; A-B-A,foreign owner,removed/replaced and unlaid-out targets fail explicitly. New accepted revision resets item mount baselines; unmount invalidates attachment and baselines.
stable_item_reveal.geometry: library traverses only actual target ancestor ScrollContent path in current modal scope; plans document transforms with existing ScrollArea nearest/centered/Insets/clamping; ordinary offscreen items are navigable.
stable_item_reveal.clipping: preflight proposed endpoints on same original tree, using current shaping/layout; save/restore only library scroll/reading metadata, never editors or application components. Fully clipped/unreachable targets reject before accepting navigation; layout must be deterministic for unchanged inputs. Arbitrary application mutations in layout are retained as for ordinary render.
stable_item_reveal.input: normal valid navigation never changes composer focus,selection,undo,marked range or editor identity; does not call host cancel/focus/click/IME commands; accepted navigation latches reading history and fences old momentum,including already-visible targets.
stable_item_reveal.motion: reuse shared ScrollArea reveal; host-clocked,Reduced Motion immediate,unclocked backend immediate. Temporarily suspend history anchor compensation only for owned explicit navigation so nested animation is not undone as reflow.
stable_item_reveal.ownership: private process-unique scroll reveal generation plus existing component mount prevents older navigation from cancelling a newer one,including public scroll-value replacement.
stable_item_reveal.status: latest accepted result only:Animating,Completed,Interrupted orRejected; a new accepted command supersedes predecessor; invalid commands do not replace it; revalidate old document/mount before layout tick; fresh wheel,layout or lifecycle ends stale navigation. No timer reasserts an unchanged business target.
stable_item_reveal.consumer: business owns initial-mount/follow deduplication; supplies real IDs/options and existing backend,never reads offsets for product pixel compensation; request normal render before publishing native scene/text/AX.
stable_item_reveal.acceptance: public/actual CoreText mixed consumer,GPU,external native,Gold7 and independent immutable consumer input remain separate; performance deferred
stable_item_reveal.target_document_geometry: Revalidate actual ScrollContent ancestor path and each target rectangle in that ancestor document, projecting nested viewports to planned endpoints. Same-extent layout movement also interrupts old navigation; current animation progress alone does not count as layout movement.
stable_item_reveal.start_alignment: For Start(Axis), derive selected-axis comfort geometry from original ScrollGeometry actual visible_viewport_rect/ancestor clip. Offscreen nested viewports initially use their own frame, then reuse SAME-tree endpoint preflight to refine actual visible clips, bounded by ancestor count+2; unsettled/unreachable clipping rejects. Consumer supplies no offsets or fabricated margin. A currently too-small clipped comfort zone is provisional when parent navigation can expose it: validate original margins against the viewport, refine on the same tree, and require usable actual END geometry; permanently unusable clipping rejects rather than pretending alignment.
stable_item_reveal.layout_input_change: A new host frame or ancestor clip input interrupts an in-flight original plan before its old animation tick; explicit retry uses new actual geometry. No editor/focus cancellation.
stable_item_reveal.anchor_round_trip: Shared reading anchor restoration resolves displacement in f64 and retains an offset for differences within the existing0.001 anchor clamp tolerance,preventing one-ULP manual-position drift after navigation stops. This tolerance does not turn explicit Start into nearest or change its requested margins.

text_surface.acceptance: public state/transactions, real Gallery and independent consumer, GPU comparison, and physical/native experience are separate evidence
text_surface.host: pass the current pointer position to TextSurface.pointer_state; None means no hover. Host owns focus/cursor routing. Before disabling, blur, deactivation or unmount call existing cancel_interaction; disabled projection always suppresses hover/pressed immediately.

hover.hit_region: visible frame including padding, intersected with ancestor clip

text_surface.ime: hover leaves marked text and selection unchanged; accepted pointer_down retains existing unmark transaction; cancellation releases capture without rolling back the visible selection or draft

presentation.motion: none; no Button wash, tint, border substitution, scaling or press animation

pressed.activation: no Button-style release activation; caret/selection/scroll feedback only
pressed.begin: accepted primary pointer_down for caret placement, text selection or scrollbar drag
pressed.outside_capture: pressed remains true while captured even outside hover region

text_surface.state_source: derive ControlState from current visible hit geometry, TextInput.disabled, and the existing pointer capture; no retained hover state or second press state machine

layout_activation_preflight.activation: Component active state may change during measure or arrange; retained production editor identity is not reconstructed for pane visibility.
layout_activation_preflight.validation: ContentHost reuses requires_text_services/needs_text at entry, after measure and after arrange, including retained exit presentation; all checks precede paint and modal focus selection.
layout_activation_preflight.failure: MissingTextServices retains application layout changes already made and cancels transient input ownership with the existing cancellation path; callers must not publish native text/AX layout from a failed render.
layout_activation_preflight.recovery: Supply a valid TextSurfaceHost and render again. Original editor value and reading attachment remain; retry does not acquire focus.
layout_activation_preflight.entry_active: Entry preflight remains conservative: an already active text subtree requires its backend even for a frame intending to collapse it. Complete collapse with a valid backend first; an inactive subtree may then omit services.
layout_activation_preflight.scope: All components opting into requires_text_services, not only TextFieldContent. Legacy label-only ButtonTextRenderer hosts remain valid. Explicit readonly label overflow retains its separate capability diagnostics.
layout_activation_preflight.zero_area: The minimal layout-driven consumer skips its inactive child arrangement at zero width or height and never shapes zero-width editor text; no generic rollback of arbitrary application callbacks is promised.

tooltip.ownership: TooltipView owns hover/focus and Escape suppression; callers own explicit visibility and actual window availability.
tooltip.escape: Dismiss the currently visible request without clearing the anchor focus or activating its action.

fresh_request: active hover false-to-true into the current visible anchor or tooltip
observed caller visibility false-to-true across render snapshots
reentry.recovery: A fresh request clears the existing dismissal latch independently of the other retained owner.
not_fresh: pointer movement that stays inside the same visible region
owner exit or blur while the other old owner remains
reentry.inactive: Ignore pointer/focus/key requests and invalidate old availability immediately; activation alone cannot restore a passive request.
reentry.controlled: Repeated true remains suppressed after Escape. An observed caller false-to-true independently clears dismissal even while old hover/focus remains; fresh active hover/focus requests are also independent.

tooltip.presentation: Reuse existing Tooltip palette, geometry, clipping and text; no new token, state protocol or motion requirement.
tooltip.acceptance: Public API, actual consumers, GPU, real native lifecycle and applicable AX/hearing/Gold7 remain separate.

content_help.entry: Content::with_help / set_help; original semantic owner description maps to native accessibilityHelp; no new AX node or visible row
content_help.timing: Existing monotonic ButtonTextRenderer motion_context clock and request_animation_frame; dwell is not an animation, so Reduced Motion does not remove it. Missing/lost clock clears pending/visible help and leaves semantic help; a fresh owner input is needed after restoration.
content_help.ownership: one per ContentHost, original retained Content mount/revision; original TooltipView paint/placement/suppression, original readonly label shaping; no editor clone
content_help.routing: topmost visible original semantic_frame intersected with its actual clip, actual interactive descendants shield parent declarations; overlay/modal/capture precede help. Pointer exit, click, scroll, Cancel/window loss, unavailable/moved anchor and unmount invalidate old requests. Fresh keyboard focus or fresh hover can request again. Disabled controls may retain explanatory help while their original activation remains rejected. Original Tooltip hit_test retains the same owner while the pointer enters its current popup, avoiding covered-row retargeting.
content_help.update: Changed text invalidates old paint and restarts dwell for an eligible unsuppressed owner. It never cancels click/Escape/geometry dismissal: only a fresh original hover/focus request can rearm. Equal text is a no-op; clear/unmount revoke, remount explicitly rebinds.
content_help.input: help never focuses, reveals, captures, edits, activates, or adds semantic identity; composing editor owns Escape before a passive help dismissal consumes it. Original actions remain exactly once.
content_help.sizing: Existing Tooltip insets/placement and UiCaption; use actual readonly shaped line ends plus tail ellipsis inside bounded host viewport. If readonly label service is absent, use the original renderer only for paragraphs that fit; otherwise keep full AX help without a clipped/blank popup. No row style or alternate font backend.

label_layout.ownership: Original Content/control owns source, semantics, hit testing, focus and interaction. Existing text host owns font registry and glyph output.
label_layout.opt_in: Content.with_label_layout(LabelOptions); supported readonly TextContent or ButtonContent only. Editable text and arbitrary containers are rejected.
label_layout.default: Unlimited natural wrapping; existing component struct literals and default render path remain unchanged.
label_layout.line_limit: None or a positive integer; zero cannot represent a limit.
overflow: Clip: retain naturally wrapped rows up to the limit and clip visible glyphs to the slot
TailEllipsis: native shaped ellipsis on the last visible row; never split composed source graphemes; insufficient whole-token space yields an empty visible row
label_layout.layout: One immutable LabelLayout supplies measurement and paint. Discard derived cache and old capability failures at each host-frame entry and new measure pass, including arrange-only slots; final arrange establishes actual slot width.
label_layout.typography: Reuse design role family, size, weight and scaled minimum line height; retain larger native fallback metrics and existing integer-point label origin.
label_layout.accessibility: Full original source and accessible name remain unchanged; synthetic ellipsis never becomes editable caret geometry.
label_layout.capability: A host missing shape_label is rejected with MissingLabelServices before successful render; no fallback to natural wrapping or stale glyphs.
label_layout.verification: Public API, actual component integration, GPU, external-screen native and matched Gold7/ClientKit visual evidence remain separate.
label_layout.intrinsic_measurement: Round intrinsic advances upward at the existing label service 1/64pt fit precision, bounded by the supplied slot; never let float conversion invent last-grapheme overflow.

compact_action.frame_policy: Minimum by default. Explicit ButtonFramePolicy::Exact uses the caller-arranged original action frame for decoration,chrome,hit and AX; no implicit minimum or insets. Standard Button measurement/minimum stays unchanged.
compact_action.decoration: CompoundButton keeps one explicit accessible action name. Decorative descendants do not export independent interactive/AX controls. Existing validation rejects interactive descendants.
compact_action.activation: ButtonContent pointer_activation_phase defaults Release. Explicit Press commits once on original primary down; release, repeated down, drag-out and cancel do not repeat that committed action. Cancel does not undo an already delivered press.
compact_action.ownership: Original Button arm,capture,cancel,hover/press motion,focus ring,disabled/loading and ContentHost original mount-bound action source remain authoritative. Keyboard/AX follow original timing independent of pointer option.
compact_action.scope: General compact caller-arranged actions,not an Agent rail component. Business item identity,layout and decorative ink remain consumer-owned.
compact_action.accessibility: Same arranged frame and original node; visible keyboard focus must remain. Exact mode is explicit and can produce small hit targets,never silently changes normal buttons.
compact_action.focus_paint: In ordinary Content child traversal the original focused Exact action branch paints after adjacent sibling chrome, retaining the shared outsetting focus ring. Component::focus_decoration_above_siblings defaults false; original ButtonContent declares its existing Exact/focused/focus_visible/enabled/non-loading predicate, CompoundButton and consumer wrappers forward to the SAME retained control without copying conditions. Parent traversal queries this declaration through the Component trait and active ancestry, never concrete downcasts. Layout/hit/AX order and overlays remain unchanged. Consumers owning child painting retain their declared order.

composition_padding_focus.entry: ContentHost::set_padding_focus(owner,Some(original_editable_descendant)); None clears; install after mount before or after first layout
composition_padding_focus.ownership: Original retained TextSurface, focus epoch, native key-chain binding, IME, selection, undo and AX node remain authoritative. No pointer/caret coordinate synthesis, editor clone or asynchronous host callback.
composition_padding_focus.routing: Only primary down in visible passive decoration without a real interactive hit. Interactive descendants, including disabled or unhandled controls, shield their bounds. Existing capture and overlay/modal routing retain precedence.
composition_padding_focus.validation: Owner and original descendant must be active and enabled; target must be editable and visible for a routed hit. Scope, subtree and retained mount must match. Removal/reinsertion or replacement requires an explicit new declaration; numeric ID reuse cannot retarget.
composition_padding_focus.preservation: Already-focused padding is consumed without repeating set_focus/reveal: preedit, selection, undo, original key epoch and caret remain untouched. A different focus owner changes atomically through the existing library focus method.
composition_padding_focus.accessibility: No extra focus target, TextInput or AX node. Original Tab, Shift+Tab, AX Focus and visible focus remain on the retained component.
composition_padding_focus.exceptions: Read-only text keeps its existing direct selection/AX behavior; decoration does not redirect to it. Secondary pointer, clipped decoration and missing/stale declarations use ordinary routing. No default component style or token value change.
composition_padding_focus.intent_query: ContentHost::padding_focus_target(&ContentEvent) returns only the original registered editable target for this primary down using the same classification as dispatch. It is a read-only same-turn host policy hint, not a general hit test or mount reservation: no event, focus/reveal, capture, caret/edit, action or key/IME epoch side effects. Real controls, open overlays and capture do not report padding; modal scope, active/availability/clip and retained mount still apply. Pending stale ownership conservatively reports None until normal reconciliation. Dispatch rechecks current state; changed geometry/availability/mount cannot use a previous query as permission.

component_event_propagation.unhandled_default: bubble along the actual target ancestor path, never through siblings behind the target
component_event_propagation.configuration: Content::bubbling_handled_events(bool) for an instance; Component::bubble_handled_event(ContentEvent) for event-specific opt-in
component_event_propagation.result: ContentResponse.consumed retains whether any recipient handled the event; ContentHost::event_bubbled reports whether the enclosing host may receive it. changed independently requests redraw.
component_event_propagation.actions: Record original actions once at each delivery; bubbling never replays the originating handler.
component_event_propagation.capture: Propagation is not capture transfer. Selection, slider and splitter ownership remains until release/cancel. A native window-drag handoff must explicitly cancel the previous interaction first.
component_event_propagation.barriers: IME input context, text transaction, focus traversal, overlay command and modal isolation retain precedence; opt-in cannot cross a modal boundary.
component_event_propagation.host_drag: Only eligible window chrome may interpret an unhandled or explicitly propagated drag as a window drag; never turn arbitrary component content into window chrome.
